correctness.rationale: For uniform initial [0,1), exact dyadic shell probabilities obey the stated reset biased-walk recurrence. Kernel cancellation at r=z(p+q r^2) yields M_p(z)=r/[z(1-r)(2p-qr)] and Lagrange/ballot coefficients give the stated finite binomial mean. With p_n=1/2+alpha/sqrt(n) and c_n=q_n/(2p_n)->1/2, the tail correction E[S^+ c_n^S] is O(1); triangular-array CLT plus uniform integrability gives sqrt(n) E X_n -> 2 E[(Z+2alpha)^+] = sqrt(2/pi)exp(-2alpha^2)+4alpha Phi(2alpha). Independently coded rational dyadic-shell integration and ballot expectation agree in 32 cases. The proof does not infer the all-n limit from those cases.
